map.输入纱支、经纬密度、缩水率等参数，综合评估面料质量等级（A/B/C）: Enter yarn count, warp/weft density, and shrink rate to comprehensively assess the fabric quality grade (A/B/C).
map.依据 GB 色牢度 1~5 级（4 级为良好）等质量指标综合评估: Comprehensive assessment by quality indicators such as GB color fastness grade 1–5 (grade 4 is good).
map.依据经纬纱支数、经纬密、缩水率与 GB 色牢度（1~5 级，4 级为良好，贴身与: Comprehensive fabric-quality assessment by warp/weft count, warp/weft density, shrink rate, and GB color fastness (grade 1–5, grade 4 good; close-fitting and dark fabrics often require ≥ grade 4).
map.💡 评估维度：织物紧度（E=0.75×经向+0.25×纬向）、缩水率（≤3%为优: 💡 Scoring dimensions: fabric cover factor (E = 0.75×warp + 0.25×weft), shrink rate (≤3% excellent), color fastness (≥ grade 4 excellent), combined score.
map.纱支 Ne 转 tex：tex = 590.5 / Ne，纱支越高纱线越细: Convert count Ne to tex: tex = 590.5 / Ne; higher count means a finer yarn.
map.织物紧度 = 纱线直径 × 密度 / 10cm，反映面料紧密程度: Fabric cover factor = yarn diameter × density / 10cm, reflecting how closely woven the fabric is.
map.缩水率≤3%为A，3~5%为B，>5%为C（经纬向取较大值）: Shrink ≤3% is A, 3%–5% B, >5% C (take the larger of warp/weft).
map.📚 深度解析：面料质量评估（紧度/克重/缩水/色牢度）: 📚 Deep Dive: Fabric Quality Assessment (cover / weight / shrink / fastness)
map.布料质检：输入经纬支数、密度、缩水与色牢度，评综合质量: Fabric QC: enter warp/weft count, density, shrink, and fastness to rate overall quality.
map.采购比选：克重与紧度关系手感与厚实: Procurement comparison: weight and cover relate to hand-feel and thickness.
map.合规提示：缩水率与色牢度关系穿着体验: Compliance note: shrink rate and fastness relate to wearing comfort.
map.算法：纱径 d(mm) ≈ 0.868/√Ne；织物紧度 E(%) = d(mm: Algorithm: yarn diameter d(mm) ≈ 0.868/√Ne; cover factor E(%) = d(mm) × density (ends/10cm); total cover = warp cover + weft cover − warp cover×weft cover/100; GSM ≈ (warp density × warp tex + weft density × weft tex)/100 × 1.05 (tex = 590.5/Ne). Then score across cover / shrink / fastness dimensions.
map.例：40Ne/523 根·10cm、40Ne/283 根·10cm、缩水 3%/: Example: 40Ne / 523 ends·10cm, 40Ne / 283 picks·10cm, shrink 3%/2%, fastness grade 4 → warp cover 71.8%, weft cover 38.8%, total cover 82.7%, estimated GSM 124.9 g/m², a normal light fabric with cover and shrink in the qualified range. If 32Ne/400, 32Ne/300 → GSM rises to 135.6 g/m².
map.紧度反映纱线覆盖程度，过高偏硬挺、透气差，过低稀疏；须与用途匹配（如衬衫宜中紧度: Cover reflects yarn coverage; too high is stiff and poorly breathable, too low is sparse; it must match the end use (e.g. shirts want medium cover for breathability).
map.GB 色牢度 1~5 级，4 级为良好（日常水洗基本不沾色）；贴身与深色面料常要: GB color fastness is grade 1–5; grade 4 is good (daily washing basically does not bleed); close-fitting and dark fabrics often require ≥ grade 4.
map.面料质量评估工具输入经纬纱支数、密度、缩水率与色牢度，综合计算织物紧度、估算克重: The fabric quality assessment tool takes warp/weft count, density, shrink rate, and fastness, comprehensively computes the fabric cover factor, estimates GSM, and gives a quality grade (A/B/C) with improvement advice, a reference for fabric inspection and process optimization.
map.计算经纬向紧度与总织物紧度: Compute warp/weft and total cover factor
map.综合缩水率、色牢度、紧度多维评分: Multi-dimensional scoring of shrink, fastness, and cover
map.输出质量等级与改进建议: Output quality grade and improvement advice
map.面料出厂质量检验与分级: Fabric factory quality inspection and grading
